scope.adjudication_unit: One row per baseline failure check, keyed physical leg_id#criterion; 93 checks consolidate to 60 physical legs.

definitions.ratio: weighted ACS nonzero incidence / weighted ASEC nonzero incidence
definitions.best_arm_method: minimum multiplicative log-distance to incidence band, normalized QED exceedance, or dead-status indicator; exact ties retained
definitions.best_arm_tie_auxiliary: When tied criterion winners disagree on a non-ranking auxiliary field, candidate_ratio_band_status is mixed_by_arm and auxiliary_by_arm preserves each result.

minimal_green_set.statement: All 93 checks/60 physical legs must stop emitting failures; GateReport is all-results and the battery is passed=not failures, so no smaller check subset can green it.
minimal_green_set.reviewed_candidate_prerequisite: Each dead QBI candidate needs either a real artifact fix or new authenticated US criterion-level exclusion plumbing plus approval.

top_five_highest_leverage.title: PUF-tax sign-aware hurdle plus conditional-quantile calibration
Retirement predictor factorial, dense validation, and sign-aware refit
Source-operator two-part carrier and amount calibration
Restore QBI ownership evidence and refit the coupled surface
Rare signed-tail donor evidence and target-specific modeling

reviewed_exclusion_support.why_no_sparse_candidates: All 48 red QEDs have minima of 48 ASEC carriers and 519 ACS carriers, above the five-carrier skip. Keogh is one-sided at ASEC 2 / ACS 0, so QED is skipped but incidence still fails; it is policy-relevant and remains a real blocker.
reviewed_exclusion_support.structural_absence_distinction: US declared structural-absence rules remove only authority-bound rows after an exact equation check; a mismatch emits a failure. They are not reviewed defect exceptions.
required_before_approval: US schema-2 register keyed exact leg+criterion
exact schema-2 fields: reason, approved_by, adjudication, approved_on, expires_on
no waiver for missing/null/invalid or real artifact defects
sealed digest and resolved receipts in terminal manifest
